description: This file defines the OrganizationsUsersService class, which manages organization user operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting users, as well as conflict checks and email notifications within a NestJS application.

classes.name: OrganizationsUsersService
classes.description: Service class for managing organization users, including CRUD operations, conflict checks, and email notifications.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users of an organization with optional email filters and attribute filters.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user within an organization, sends signup email.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from an organization.

methods.name: checkForUsernameConflicts
methods.description: Checks if a username is already taken within the organization.

methods.name: getUsersByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple users by their IDs, ensuring they belong to the organization.
